name: Ojou-sama Express
source:
Ultra luxury limited express "Vega" crossing Japan in 15 days from August 1 to 15 from Hokkaido to Kyushu stopping at each station for 24 hours. The main character rides this express and goes to a trip without destination. What awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
8月1日至15日，超豪华特急“Vega”穿越日本，从北海道出发，前往九州，各站24小时停靠。主角乘坐这趟快车，去往没有目的地的旅行。等待他的是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
